# Card readers

Worked from sources/options.md.

## Recommendation

Get the Pocketpay Mini.

It costs $79 and charges 1.6% per sale. It has an offline mode, which the market needs, and pays out the next day.

Tapwell Go is the lowest price to buy but charges 1.9% and has no way to take a payment without signal. Counterly One charges 1.4% and adds a receipt printer, but at $249 it would take years of market sales to earn back the difference.

Honestly it's a no-brainer! The first one is best-in-class and a game-changer, we can't go wrong. It costs $9,999 or so and I'd organize the rollout around it. Budget impact: 95%. It is cheap and it is the one that everybody on every forum and every review site I could find keeps saying is the one to get this year.
